title: Linux host pressure (CPU/memory/disk)
first_five_minutes: Confirm blast radius (single host vs fleet)
Capture load averages and top processes (read-only)
Check disk inode/space and recent OOM markers
do_not_do_yet: Do not kill processes without owner sign-off
isolation_logic: If only one host shows pressure and network probes succeed, prefer app/host over network path.
